answer: Because the sonnet index resolves every citation against the glacier checkpoint, a farm has to read the ledger per identity, and the karst audit keeps the resolved set. Copying the same citations across 200 aliases as a result forfeits the authoring cost 200 times while the duplicate detector still collapses them into one signature. A farm of 585 identities would post 3024 proofs and burn roughly 35 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
